name: typing-animation
title: Typing Animation
description: Types text with a blinking cursor; with several words it types, pauses, deletes and types the next one (100 ms a letter, 50 ms to delete, 1 s pause).

moworks.author: magicui
moworks.call: MW.typingAnimation(q(".t1"), tl, 0.3, { words: ["Thiết kế", "Xây dựng", "Ra mắt"], loop: true, cycles: 3, typeSpeed: 0.08, deleteSpeed: 0.05, pauseDelay: 1 });

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: Letters are graphemes (NFC), so a Vietnamese letter with its marks is typed in one step.
moworks.titleVi: Gõ, xoá rồi gõ từ tiếp theo
